sentence: Call out the womberombombo or lose the fyts forever.

wombos.definition: When you're out and about and you hear someone say a wombombo that you said earlier in the day; you have to call it out when it happens or it doesn't exist
wombos.example: Yo he just dropped a queanemis — that's a Womberombombo.

wombos.definition: Fine things — a plural noun for attractive people or desirable situations that meet an elevated standard of fineness.
wombos.example: He showed up to the farket specifically looking for fyts.
